name: r2a_negated
hypothesis: Symmetry test: asking whether BTC movement CONTRADICTS the strongest side, then inverting, should give the same agreement as the direct wording. A large gap means the model is wording-sensitive, not judging the evidence.
instructions: Does observed BTC movement contradict Polymarket's strongest side ({strongest_side})? {strongest_side} requires {direction_word} BTC movement, so answer high if BTC is moving against {strongest_side}. Weigh window direction against recent tick direction, consistency and acceleration, and whether contract movement works against that side. Judge directional contradiction, not settlement probability.
